chapterInfo.content:
6
Odiyifoɔ no frɛ ne ne hyɛ
1 # Yoh 12.41 Afe a Ɔhene Usia wuiɛ no, mehunuu AWURADE sɛ ɔte ahennwa a ɛkorɔn a wɔama soɔ so, na n’atadeɛ mmuano ayɛ asɔrefie ma. 2Serafim gyinagyina ne nkyɛn. Wɔn mu biara wɔ ntaban nsia. Wɔn mu biara de ntaban mmienu kata wɔn anim. Na wɔde mmienu kata wɔn nan ho, na wɔde mmienu nso tu. 3#Adi 4.8; Hab 3.3 Na oyi team kyerɛ oyi sɛ:
Kronkron, kronkron, kronkron ne asafo AWURADE!
N’animuonyam ahyɛ asase nyinaa ma.
4 # Hes 10.4; Adi 15.8 Na apono ase wosoe, deɛ na ɔreteam no nne nti, na wisie yɛɛ ɛdan no ma.
5 # Eks 33.20 Ɛnna mekaa sɛ: Mennue, na mayera; na meyɛ onipa a m’ano ho nteɛ, na mete ɔman a wɔn ano ho nteɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ Ɔhene, asafo AWURADE, na m’ani ahu no yi!
6Ɛnna Serafim no mu baako tu baa me nkyɛn, na ɔkura nsramma a ɔde daban kɔfaa no afɔrebukyia no soɔ; 7#Sak 3.4 na ɔde kaa m’ano kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, yei aka w’ano, na wɔayi w’amumuyɛ kɔ, na wɔakata wo bɔne so.
8Na metee AWURADE nne sɛ ɔse: Hwan na mensoma no, na hwan na ɔbɛkɔ ama yɛn? Na mese: Meni, soma me! 9#Mat 13.11-15; Yoh 12.40; Aso 28.26-27 Na ɔse: Kɔ na kɔka kyerɛ ɔman yi sɛ:
Teɛ ara na monteɛ, na monnte aseɛ,
na hunu ara na monhunu, na monnhunu mu.
10 # Deut 29.4 Ma ɔman yi akoma mpirim,
na wɔn aso mu nyɛ duru,
na ka wɔn ani femfam so,
na wɔamfa wɔn ani anhunu,
na wɔamfa wɔn aso ante,
na wɔn akoma anhunu mu,
na wɔansakyera, na wɔansa wɔn yadeɛ.
11Na mese: O AWURADE, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Na ɔse:
Ɛnkɔsi sɛ nkuro bɛdane akurofo
a obi nte mu,
na afie atɔ mpan a onipa nni mu,
na asase no asɛe ayɛ fo koraa,
12na AWURADE aka nnipa akɔ akyirikyiri,
na amamfo adɔɔso wɔ asase no soɔ.
13 # Yes 4.3 Na sɛ ɛka abupɛn du mu baako wɔ mu mpo a,
wɔbɛsane ahye wɔn,
sɛ odum anaa dupɔn a wɔato ahwe fam,
nanso ne sini da so ara si hɔ
berɛ a wɔatwa. Na n’aba kronkron no ne dunsini no.

Afe a Ɔhene Usia wuiɛ no, mehunuu AWURADE sɛ ɔte ahennwa a ɛkorɔn a wɔama soɔ so, na n’atadeɛ mmuano ayɛ asɔrefie ma. Serafim gyinagyina ne nkyɛn. Wɔn mu biara wɔ ntaban nsia. Wɔn mu biara de ntaban mmienu kata wɔn anim. Na wɔde mmienu kata wɔn nan ho, na wɔde mmienu nso tu. Na oyi team kyerɛ oyi sɛ:
Kronkron, kronkron, kronkron ne asafo AWURADE!
N’animuonyam ahyɛ asase nyinaa ma.
Na apono ase wosoe, deɛ na ɔreteam no nne nti, na wisie yɛɛ ɛdan no ma.
Ɛnna mekaa sɛ: Mennue, na mayera; na meyɛ onipa a m’ano ho nteɛ, na mete ɔman a wɔn ano ho nteɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ Ɔhene, asafo AWURADE, na m’ani ahu no yi!
Ɛnna Serafim no mu baako tu baa me nkyɛn, na ɔkura nsramma a ɔde daban kɔfaa no afɔrebukyia no soɔ; na ɔde kaa m’ano kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, yei aka w’ano, na wɔayi w’amumuyɛ kɔ, na wɔakata wo bɔne so.
Na metee AWURADE nne sɛ ɔse: Hwan na mensoma no, na hwan na ɔbɛkɔ ama yɛn? Na mese: Meni, soma me! Na ɔse: Kɔ na kɔka kyerɛ ɔman yi sɛ:
Teɛ ara na monteɛ, na monnte aseɛ,
na hunu ara na monhunu, na monnhunu mu.
Ma ɔman yi akoma mpirim,
na wɔn aso mu nyɛ duru,
na ka wɔn ani femfam so,
na wɔamfa wɔn ani anhunu,
na wɔamfa wɔn aso ante,
na wɔn akoma anhunu mu,
na wɔansakyera, na wɔansa wɔn yadeɛ.
Na mese: O AWURADE, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Na ɔse:
Ɛnkɔsi sɛ nkuro bɛdane akurofo
a obi nte mu,
na afie atɔ mpan a onipa nni mu,
na asase no asɛe ayɛ fo koraa,
na AWURADE aka nnipa akɔ akyirikyiri,
na amamfo adɔɔso wɔ asase no soɔ.
Na sɛ ɛka abupɛn du mu baako wɔ mu mpo a,
wɔbɛsane ahye wɔn,
sɛ odum anaa dupɔn a wɔato ahwe fam,
nanso ne sini da so ara si hɔ

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
